strengths: Clear introduction of your role and purpose.
areas_for_improvement: Follow up when the patient deflects.
Ask about medications and how he takes them.
Explain lab results in plain language and check understanding.
next_attempt_suggestions: Before sensitive topics, normalise them: 'Lots of teens I see have trouble going to the bathroom regularly. Has that ever happened to you?'
Ask: 'How do you usually take your metformin on school days?'
After reviewing labs, say what one number means and ask Wyatt to explain it back.
feedback.summary: A warm, well-structured start with a strong diet recall. The biggest gap was dropping the constipation topic after Wyatt deflected, and not connecting his labs to his diet.
feedback.interpretation: Use the total as a discussion aid, not a pass/fail grade. A score of 1 in professionalism, safety, or clinical reasoning should trigger review even when the total is high.
